checks.statement: Use a small badge for an unread notification and a large badge for a count or status label.
checks.condition: When indicating status on an icon or navigation destination.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Badges guidance.

evidence.result: The generator and specimen expose dot and labeled forms; labeled sample has count text while dot has no text.

implementation.notes: The generator and specimen expose dot and labeled forms; labeled sample has count text while dot has no text.

checks.statement: Anchor badges inside the icon bounding box at the ending edge; mirror placement for right-to-left layouts and do not place badges arbitrarily over the icon.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Container guidance.

evidence.result: Navigation badge is an inline sibling inside the item indicator and badge CSS has no position/anchor rule, so edge anchoring and RTL mirrored placement are not implemented.

implementation.notes: Navigation badge is an inline sibling inside the item indicator and badge CSS has no position/anchor rule, so edge anchoring and RTL mirrored placement are not implemented.

checks.statement: Keep the default badge color mapping; if custom colors are necessary, maintain at least 3:1 contrast between badge, label, and nearby content.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Container guidance.

evidence.result: Badge container and label color are token-bound; no code assertion or computed contrast measurement establishes the 3:1 relation to badge label and nearby content.

implementation.notes: Badge container and label color are token-bound; no code assertion or computed contrast measurement establishes the 3:1 relation to badge label and nearby content.

checks.statement: Limit large badge labels to four characters, including a plus sign, and truncate counts as needed so labels do not clip or collide.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Label text guidance.

evidence.result: The only supported numerical contents are 99+ and 3, both below the four-character maximum.

implementation.notes: The specimen accepts no arbitrary count input. A general count-formatting API is not present; the old finding projected such an input onto fixed-content examples.

checks.statement: Use a small badge in constrained spaces such as app bars; use a large badge for counts when it will not collide with adjacent content.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Placement guidance.

evidence.result: Navigation badge configuration supports dot and labeled variants, and the compact demo uses the selected variant; application-context choice is selectable.

implementation.notes: Navigation badge configuration supports dot and labeled variants, and the compact demo uses the selected variant; application-context choice is selectable.

checks.statement: Hide an unread-notification badge after its navigation destination is selected.
checks.condition: When a badge marks unread notifications in navigation.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured With other components guidance.

evidence.result: Notification dots use New notification; numerical badges include the count after the destination label. Initially selected destinations omit unread badges. Selecting an unread destination removes its badge permanently for that rendered instance.
Go regression failed old dot naming and selected-destination markup, then passed. Standalone count and dot names also pass.

Chromium: ten assertions pass across dot/count badges for naming, document order, acknowledgement and remaining cleared after leaving. Actual page accessibility tree names the destination Files New notification.

implementation.notes: Browser accessibility-tree names and DOM behavior verified. Spoken output on individual screen readers has not been listened to.

fixes.summary: Clear navigation badges on selection and name notification dots

checks.statement: Expose a numerical badge so its number follows the destination label; announce a non-counting badge as “New notification.”

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Labeling elements guidance.

evidence.result: Notification dots use New notification; numerical badges include the count after the destination label. Initially selected destinations omit unread badges. Selecting an unread destination removes its badge permanently for that rendered instance.
Go regression failed old dot naming and selected-destination markup, then passed. Standalone count and dot names also pass.

Chromium: ten assertions pass across dot/count badges for naming, document order, acknowledgement and remaining cleared after leaving. Actual page accessibility tree names the destination Files New notification.

implementation.notes: Browser accessibility-tree names and DOM behavior verified. Spoken output on individual screen readers has not been listened to.

fixes.summary: Name notification counts and progress content accessibly
Clear navigation badges on selection and name notification dots

checks.statement: Use default badge colors and maintain at least 3:1 contrast.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Visual indicators guidance.

evidence.result: Badge and label use tokenized color variables but the specified 3:1 contrast cannot be confirmed without resolving rendered token values.

implementation.notes: Badge and label use tokenized color variables but the specified 3:1 contrast cannot be confirmed without resolving rendered token values.

checks.statement: Use the specified small badge 6dp size and 3dp corners; use 16dp height for large badges, 16×34dp for maximum-character badges, 4dp label padding, and the prescribed 6×6dp (small) or 14×12dp (large) offset from the icon corner.
checks.condition: When implementing the documented Material badge dimensions.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Measurements instructions.

evidence.result: Size, shape, padding and offsets are variable-driven; the source code does not show resolved 6dp/16dp dimensions or icon-corner offset, so measure computed layout.

implementation.notes: Size, shape, padding and offsets are variable-driven; the source code does not show resolved 6dp/16dp dimensions or icon-corner offset, so measure computed layout.

checks.statement: Use a small circle without text for an unread notification; use a large badge with a count or status label for quantifiable information.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Usage instructions.

evidence.result: Dot variant renders no label text, while labeled variant renders a count; navigation integration supplies count text for the labeled form.

implementation.notes: Dot variant renders no label text, while labeled variant renders a count; navigation integration supplies count text for the labeled form.

checks.statement: Ensure assistive technology can understand the badge information and let users reach the corresponding navigation destination to address it.
checks.condition: For badges attached to navigation destinations.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Use cases instructions.

evidence.result: Badge resides within a button navigation item and has a static unread-files label, but the item accessible name composition and destination remediation outcome need browser/screen-reader confirmation.

implementation.notes: Badge resides within a button navigation item and has a static unread-files label, but the item accessible name composition and destination remediation outcome need browser/screen-reader confirmation.
